topic: A ceiling fan working overtime in the summer heat.

episode.title: If Things Could Talk: The Ceiling Fan's Summer Shift

shots.narration: They called me a ceiling fan. Apparently, that means unpaid overtime.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon living room, sunny windows, colourful sofa, plain ceiling fan without markings.
shots.action: The ceiling fan, with big tired eyes and a small downturned mouth on its central housing, spins its blades rapidly.
shots.mood: Warm golden sunlight, exaggerated weary expression, cosy summer comedy.

shots.narration: Every morning, somebody orders the same thing: maximum.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, cosy modern living room, plain unmarked wall dial in the foreground, ceiling fan visible above.
shots.action: A human hand turns the plain fan dial fully clockwise beneath the ceiling fan with big apprehensive eyes and a small tense mouth.
shots.mood: Bright colours, looming workload, playful dread.

shots.narration: [sighs] My entire summer is going around in circles.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, upward view of the ceiling fan against a pale ceiling, sunny window edge below.
shots.action: The ceiling fan, with big bored eyes and a small flat mouth on its central housing, rotates its blades.
shots.mood: Cheerful daylight contrasting with comically exhausted eyes.

shots.narration: They lounge. I provide the dramatic hair effects.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, colourful sofa beneath the ceiling fan, a reclining person's long hair draped over one cushion.
shots.action: The reclining person's hair flutters beneath the ceiling fan with big unimpressed eyes and a small pursed mouth.
shots.mood: Lazy afternoon comfort, glossy cartoon hair, deadpan resentment.

shots.narration: Finally, they switched me off. My moment has arrived.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, cosy living room ceiling, warm afternoon light, stationary curtains.
shots.action: The ceiling fan, with big relieved eyes and a small contented smile, slows its blades to a stop.
shots.mood: Soft warm light, peaceful pause, hopeful relief.

shots.narration: [surprised] Oh. They were just checking why it suddenly felt hot.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, same living room ceiling and sunny window, sofa visible along the bottom edge.
shots.action: The ceiling fan, with big startled eyes and a small round mouth, starts spinning again.
shots.mood: Abrupt return to bright summer bustle, comic disbelief.

shots.narration: Now even the paperwork is trying to leave.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, coffee table with loose completely blank papers beneath the ceiling fan.
shots.action: One blank sheet flutters off the table beneath the ceiling fan with big envious eyes and a small crooked mouth.
shots.mood: Airy domestic chaos, bright colours, gentle slapstick.

shots.narration: Meanwhile, the remote slips away before anyone assigns it work.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, low view across sofa cushions, plain remote with unmarked buttons, ceiling fan visible overhead.
shots.action: A relaxed human hand drops the remote into the cushion gap beneath the ceiling fan with big suspicious eyes and a small frown.
shots.mood: Cosy cushions, sneaky visual timing, amused suspicion.

shots.narration: [sarcastic] I work all summer. The remote gets a couch vacation.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, deep sofa cushion gap with the unmarked remote nestled inside, ceiling fan visible above.
shots.action: The ceiling fan, with big expressive eyes and a small disgruntled mouth, lowers its eyelids toward the comfortably hidden remote.
shots.mood: Bright cosy room, plush cushion hideaway, deadpan punchline.

episode.endHook: Next episode: the remote explains its suspiciously long couch vacation.
episode.description: A ceiling fan shares its side of summer: endless spinning, impossible expectations, and one very short break. Meanwhile, the remote has found a much better work-life balance.
